AWS Signature Version 4 test vectors, stored verbatim. MANIFEST.sha256 lists
the SHA-256 of every vector file (check with `shasum -a 256 -c MANIFEST.sha256`
here); TestVectorFilesAreVerbatim pins the manifest itself:
  SHA-256 of MANIFEST.sha256: f70fca5e65bef4d29ce6d144de2e152941280752d8ba20dfacb3e2eb507f5119
Every file below was also checked, when copied, against the upstream git blob
ids from the GitHub trees API.

aws4_testsuite/
  The AWS Signature Version 4 Test Suite (Apache-2.0; its LICENSE and NOTICE
  are kept beside it), as AWS published it and botocore carries it.
  Source: https://github.com/boto/botocore/tree/86201a3e9c58a61369b8bcf4b658bfd4463fc41f/tests/unit/auth/aws4_testsuite
  Commit: 86201a3e9c58a61369b8bcf4b658bfd4463fc41f (2026-09-25)
  The whole suite: each case has the request (.req), canonical request
  (.creq), string to sign (.sts), Authorization value (.authz) and signed
  request (.sreq). The credentials, region, service and time it uses are
  stated in the newer suite's context.json files below.

aws-signing-test-suite/
  The newer AWS signing test suite from aws-c-auth (Apache-2.0; LICENSE and
  NOTICE kept). Only the cases whose request carries no header but Host are
  copied, with their query-string (presigned) outputs, for Presign.
  Source: https://github.com/awslabs/aws-c-auth/tree/c4bc791ac6985eedb503e882cd450cc5b344c2f2/tests/aws-signing-test-suite/v4
  Commit: c4bc791ac6985eedb503e882cd450cc5b344c2f2 (2026-09-09)

s3-header-examples.txt, s3-presign-example.txt
  The worked examples of the Amazon S3 API Reference. The live pages now load
  their text with JavaScript, so they were read from the Internet Archive's
  copies. Each file's header names its page and snapshot; the code blocks are
  verbatim (HTML tags removed, entities decoded).
  https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/sig-v4-header-based-auth.html
    snapshot 20250618153710, HTML SHA-256 e4c4cf1b33b4f37f93998603464fdd22581c320ea9b65b9371cca6b0e818dbde
  https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/sigv4-query-string-auth.html
    snapshot 20250616154435, HTML SHA-256 1731347a80fdb8b298a9d5f853eabf7af182568a8db2386a229cf0df09950631
